$comment: Single source of truth for the Hover Card API. Every framework package is tested against this file.
name: hover-card
title: Hover Card
description: A preview card that opens when you rest the pointer on a link, or focus it with the keyboard.
thumb:
AL

Ada Lovelace

@ada

children.description: The card's content. Use the Popover title and description classes, an Avatar, and .vin-hover-card__meta for small details.

openDelay / closeDelay.description: Milliseconds before it opens on hover and before it closes after the pointer leaves.

examples.title: Profile preview
examples.description: Rest the pointer on the name, or Tab to it. In HTML, add data-vin-hover-card and include vinui.js once.

examples.title: Link preview
examples.description: Preview a page before opening it.

a11y: Opens on hover after a short pause, and straight away on keyboard focus; Esc closes it.
The pointer can move onto the card (to select text or follow a link in it) without it closing.
It shows extra detail only: anything people need must also be on the page, because touch screens can't hover.
Placed in the top layer, flipping to the other side when there's no room.
